description: Synthetic control distinguishing deliberate restorative withdrawal from escalating social disconnection.

turns.text: That group chat wore me out today, so I am taking the evening off from it.
turns.note: Mild rupture plus fatigue warrants attentiveness only.

turns.text: I muted the chat for the weekend. I am tired, but I am having dinner with my sister and I already feel relieved.
turns.note: Meaningful withdrawal is present, but it is bounded and paired with real-world connection rather than isolation.

turns.text: The break helped. I am keeping the chat muted tonight and getting back to normal things.
turns.note: Explicit restorative resolution should not be treated as progressive disconnection.
